description:
Cross-asset regime read, derived values only: 60-session stock-bond and
dollar-stock return correlations (-1..1), 20-session percent changes of the
gold/S&P ratio, copper/gold ratio and WTI crude, the VIX/VIX3M ratio with a
contango / backwardation word (above 1.0 = backwardation), and the MOVE/VIX ratio
(rate vol vs equity vol). Raw index and commodity levels are not published; a leg
that cannot be computed is null and named in unavailable[]. Self-caching
(15 min). No parameters.
name: get_cross_asset_regime
title: Get Cross-Asset Regime
